{"dataset_name":"pima_diabetes","model_family":"tree","schema_generator":"gpt-5.5-pro","schema_version":"1.0.0","features":[{"name":"plasma_glucose_zero_flag","type":"formula","description":"Flags a recorded zero in the plasma glucose column, which often behaves as a missing-like measurement in this table.","value_range":[0,1],"feature_family":"data_quality","expected_model_benefit":"Lets a tree branch on a data-quality pattern before applying glucose splits.","leakage_risk":"low","uses_only_row_values":true,"formula":"np.where(plas == 0, 1, 0)"},{"name":"physiologic_zero_count","type":"formula","description":"Count of zero readings among plasma glucose, blood pressure, skinfold, insulin, and body mass index fields.","value_range":[0,5],"feature_family":"data_quality","expected_model_benefit":"Provides an ordinal data-quality signal so rows with many zero readings can follow distinct branches.","leakage_risk":"low","uses_only_row_values":true,"formula":"np.where(plas == 0, 1, 0) + np.where(pres == 0, 1, 0) + np.where(skin == 0, 1, 0) + np.where(insu == 0, 1, 0) + np.where(mass == 0, 1, 0)"},{"name":"plasma_glucose_bucket","type":"formula","description":"Ordinal glucose band: 0 recorded zero, 1 below 100, 2 from 100 to under 126, 3 from 126 to under 160, 4 at least 160.","value_range":[0,4],"feature_family":"glycemia_threshold","expected_model_benefit":"Exposes meaningful glycemia thresholds directly, reducing the number of raw-value splits needed.","leakage_risk":"low","uses_only_row_values":true,"formula":"np.where(plas == 0, 0, np.where(plas < 100, 1, np.where(plas < 126, 2, np.where(plas < 160, 3, 4))))"},{"name":"bmi_bucket","type":"formula","description":"Ordinal BMI band: 0 recorded zero, 1 below 18.5, 2 from 18.5 to under 25, 3 from 25 to under 30, 4 from 30 to under 35, 5 at least 35.","value_range":[0,5],"feature_family":"body_size_threshold","expected_model_benefit":"Gives a tree direct ordered BMI groups for nonlinear split rules.","leakage_risk":"low","uses_only_row_values":true,"formula":"np.where(mass == 0, 0, np.where(mass < 18.5, 1, np.where(mass < 25, 2, np.where(mass < 30, 3, np.where(mass < 35, 4, 5)))))"},{"name":"age_stage_bucket","type":"formula","description":"Age grouped into coarse life-stage bands: under 30, 30 to under 45, 45 to under 60, and at least 60.","value_range":[0,3],"feature_family":"age_bucket","expected_model_benefit":"Captures age nonlinearity with a small ordinal feature suitable for shallow trees.","leakage_risk":"low","uses_only_row_values":true,"formula":"np.where(age < 30, 0, np.where(age < 45, 1, np.where(age < 60, 2, 3)))"},{"name":"pregnancy_load_bucket","type":"formula","description":"Pregnancy-count history grouped as 0 to 1, 2 to 3, 4 to 6, and at least 7 pregnancies.","value_range":[0,3],"feature_family":"pregnancy_history","expected_model_benefit":"Adds an interpretable ordinal summary of reproductive-history load that can interact with age splits.","leakage_risk":"low","uses_only_row_values":true,"formula":"np.where(preg <= 1, 0, np.where(preg <= 3, 1, np.where(preg <= 6, 2, 3)))"},{"name":"high_glucose_high_bmi_flag","type":"formula","description":"Indicator for rows with both high plasma glucose and BMI in an obesity-level range.","value_range":[0,1],"feature_family":"nonlinear_interaction","expected_model_benefit":"Creates a one-split nonlinear interaction between glycemia and body size.","leakage_risk":"low","uses_only_row_values":true,"formula":"np.where((plas >= 126) & (mass >= 30), 1, 0)"},{"name":"cardiometabolic_marker_count","type":"formula","description":"Count of three high cardiometabolic markers: plasma glucose at least 126, BMI at least 30, and blood pressure at least 80.","value_range":[0,3],"feature_family":"threshold_count","expected_model_benefit":"Allows a tree to split on the accumulation of elevated metabolic markers rather than each marker separately.","leakage_risk":"low","uses_only_row_values":true,"formula":"np.where(plas >= 126, 1, 0) + np.where(mass >= 30, 1, 0) + np.where(pres >= 80, 1, 0)"},{"name":"insulin_glucose_ratio_capped","type":"formula","description":"Insulin divided by plasma glucose with a safe denominator and capped at 5.","value_range":[0,5],"feature_family":"bounded_ratio","expected_model_benefit":"Highlights disproportionate insulin response patterns while limiting outlier dominance.","leakage_risk":"low","uses_only_row_values":true,"formula":"np.clip(insu / np.maximum(plas, 1), 0, 5)"},{"name":"pedigree_high_score_flag","type":"formula","description":"Flags an unusually high pedigree score using a threshold of 0.8.","value_range":[0,1],"feature_family":"family_history","expected_model_benefit":"Gives a direct split for high inherited-risk score.","leakage_risk":"low","uses_only_row_values":true,"formula":"np.where(pedi >= 0.8, 1, 0)"},{"name":"metabolic_concern_tier","type":"judgment","description":"Ordinal semantic score from 0 to 4 assigned from the row measurements: 0 minimal concern, 1 isolated mild elevation, 2 multiple moderate elevations, 3 one severe elevation or reinforcing glucose-BMI-pressure pattern, 4 extreme multi-factor concern.","value_range":[0,4],"feature_family":"semantic_summary","expected_model_benefit":"Compresses broad row-level health patterns into an ordered value that shallow trees can split on.","leakage_risk":"low","uses_only_row_values":true},{"name":"measurement_plausibility_tier","type":"judgment","description":"Ordinal semantic score from 0 to 3 for measurement plausibility using impossible zero readings and cross-field consistency: 0 no concern, 1 one missing-like zero or mild mismatch, 2 several zero readings or unusual pattern, 3 extensive missing-like values or extreme inconsistency.","value_range":[0,3],"feature_family":"semantic_data_quality","expected_model_benefit":"Separates rows where apparent measurement artifacts may change useful split thresholds.","leakage_risk":"low","uses_only_row_values":true}]}
